title: Implement the argument surface, refusal codes and non-interactive contract
statement: Implement the documented flags including the explicit consent options, reject API keys as arguments, refuse on any missing decision in non-interactive mode, and publish the exit-code mapping in `--help` and in tests.
notes: ⚠️ NON-INTERACTIVE MODEL-USE CONFIRMATION IS UNRESOLVED (EVD-0128). selectModel refuses when it cannot ask, because --provider and --model alone do not grant model use. This task must decide how a fresh non-interactive setup supplies that confirmation. ⚠️ THE HELP MUST NAME --research tavily AS THE WAY TO ENABLE RESEARCH LATER (EVD-0127), matching the hint every user-disabled research outcome carries. ⚠️ DECLARED NON-SECRET IDENTITIES NEED AN INPUT (D22, EVD-0131). A model whose endpoint cannot be canonicalised or whose request profile holds unbounded inputs has no compatibility key without a declared identity, and setup and launch refuse it. This task's argument surface must provide a way to declare the endpoint and request identities, validated as non-secret labels, or such configurations cannot complete setup. ⚠️ LANDED 2026-09-24 (EVD-0139, commit 4f07b18 and the credential-shape guard after it). All three notes above are closed through the command. NON-INTERACTIVE MODEL USE: `--model-use approve|deny` is the confirmation given in advance, with the confirmation text printed in full before either answer is applied; it confirms and does not choose. Reaching it needed `--inspect approve|deny` as well, because the inspection question had no non-interactive answer either and such a run stopped before the model phase. DECLARED IDENTITIES: `--endpoint-identity`, checked by the one canonicaliser (moved to `lib/declared-identity.mjs` so an argument is still checked before anything is installed), and `--request-identity`, checked against the pattern its schema declares. Both are COMMITTED to `.pi/kiln.json`, because the key is recomputed at every setup and every launch; `bin/start-kiln.mjs` passes them to `checkLaunch`. Neither may be in the shape of a credential — an issuer prefix, a JWT, a long opaque token, one beside a word, or one routed as an endpoint path segment — and that is an argument check, so nothing is installed, written or committed first. HELP names every option and says `--research tavily` is what turns research on. EXIT CODES: authentication became its own class, 18, because "connect a provider in Pi" cannot be answered by rerunning with flags. ⚠️ WHAT THIS TASK DOES NOT CLOSE, DECLARED RATHER THAN IMPLIED: a shape check is not a secret detector, and a declared identity is committed and printed by design; `bin/start-kiln.mjs` still cannot START a custom-provider project, which is TSK-0037's (D2), so the launch control reaches `checkLaunch` and stops there; and ACC-0084's launch-side classes (`EXIT.UNUSABLE`, launch failure) are not observed through this command, because the selection phase refuses first in every case that would reach them. ACC-0084 stays not-evaluated until those are assessed against EVD-0139.
